topic.title: Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake System Memory Map

body.p: GSM size is fixed at 8GB in HW, DSM size is fixed to 128MB in BIOS as a workaround to configure DSM/GSM as ‘WC’ cache type. This workaround is enabled by default and a policy is implemented to disable the workaround. OEMs can choose to disable the workaround.
For ARLS Refresh, HW Fix Available, so workaround is not needed.
body.note: TXT SINIT and HSTI had hardcoded assumptions about TSEG, GSM/DSM and TOLUD being adjacent to each other. This assumption is now removed in SINIT, HSTI and Chipsec.
